rules.constraint: Validate at trusted boundaries; use safe query/command/output APIs.
rules.task: Constrain input shape/size; keep untrusted data out of executable syntax.
rules.acceptance: Malformed/injection input is rejected or stays data; valid input works.
rules.verification: Test malformed and injection payloads plus legitimate input.

rules.constraint: Constrain paths, uploads and sizes; preserve unrelated files.
rules.task: Use contained paths and permitted file types/sizes for this feature.
rules.acceptance: Traversal and oversized files fail without unrelated changes; allowed files work.
rules.verification: Test traversal, limits and a valid operation in temporary directories.

rules.task: Apply destination rules and redirect checks for the actual service.
rules.acceptance: Unapproved destinations/redirects fail; approved requests work.
rules.verification: Test destination and redirect restrictions without contacting private networks.
